title: Add DNS over HTTPS option for fenix browser.
body:
### Why/User Benefit/User Problem

Protecting privacy. 
Be consistent with Firefox for desktop.

### What/Requirements

add option for DNS over HTTPS (DoH).

### Acceptance Criteria (how do I know when I’m done?)

providing an option in system preference -> general. (Same as firefox for desktop).

┆Issue is synchronized with this [Jira Task](https://mozilla-hub.atlassian.net/browse/FNXV2-13331)
author: Participant 1
scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
